*MANTL accelerates lending momentum in the banking market as Pennsylvania-based bank modernizes consumer lending with omnichannel origination for personal loans and vehicle loans*


**PLANO, Texas — Nov. 5, 2026 —** Alkami Technology, Inc. (Nasdaq: ALKT) (“Alkami”), a[digital sales and service platform provider](https://www.alkami.com/) for financial institutions in the U.S., today announced that[Fidelity Bank](https://www.bankatfidelity.com/) is live with[MANTL Loan Origination](https://www.alkami.com/mantl-onboarding-account-opening/loan-origination/) in less than three months after kickoff, unifying consumer loan origination across physical and digital banking channels to deliver a faster, more streamlined experience for borrowers and employees. Fidelity Bank is now originating personal loans and vehicle loans through MANTL.


As an existing[Alkami Digital Banking](https://www.alkami.com/digital-banking-solutions/) customer, Fidelity Bank expanded its relationship with Alkami by implementing MANTL Loan Origination to modernize consumer lending. As the bank evaluated a new loan origination system, it prioritized automation and operational efficiency while also seeking the ability to deliver a connected online borrowing experience for the first time. By replacing siloed legacy systems with MANTL Loan Origination, Fidelity Bank streamlined underwriting,[fraud prevention](https://www.alkami.com/fraud-prevention/) , and credit decisioning while creating a seamless lending experience regardless of where borrowers choose to apply.


“MANTL delivers a faster, more seamless lending experience while preserving the personalized service that defines Fidelity Bank. This investment strengthens both the client experience and our operational efficiency,” said Daniel J. Santaniello, president and chief executive officer of Fidelity Bank.


Ruth Turkington, executive vice president and chief banking officer at Fidelity Bank, added, “Service equates to speed when delivering an exceptional client experience. By unifying our digital and in-person lending experience, we’re making it easier for clients to access financing while allowing our bankers to focus on building relationships.”


With MANTL Loan Origination, Fidelity Bank can automate decisioning, enable straight-through processing, and reduce manual work through configurable workflows, integrated identity verification, and intelligent credit decisioning. These capabilities give branch teams more time to build relationships instead of entering data, while enabling Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) and underwriting teams to work more efficiently and confidently, ultimately accelerating loan processing.


“Fidelity Bank’s implementation reflects the accelerating momentum behind MANTL Loan Origination as more financial institutions seek to modernize consumer lending rather than navigate the complexity of legacy systems,” said Benjamin Conant, chief product and technology officer at Alkami. “Going live in a few months demonstrates how motivated and engaged financial institutions can rapidly deploy a modern lending platform that improves operational efficiency while delivering a modern digital experience borrowers don’t often get from regional and community financial institutions—creating a meaningful competitive differentiator in a market increasingly shaped by digital-first expectations.”


To learn how MANTL can modernize lending and empower your team, or to schedule a demo, click[here](https://www.alkami.com/demo/mantl-account-opening/) .


To learn more about the Alkami Digital Sales & Service Platform, visit[here](https://www.alkami.com/digital-banking-solutions/) . To request a demo, visit[here](https://www.alkami.com/demo/digital-banking-solutions/) .


**About Alkami**


[Alkami](https://www.alkami.com/press-room/) provides a digital sales and service platform for U.S.[banks](https://www.alkami.com/banks/) and credit unions. Our unified Platform integrates onboarding, digital banking, and data and marketing—each solution can stand alone, but together they deliver more—to help institutions onboard, engage, and grow relationships. As the future shifts toward Anticipatory Banking, we help data-informed bankers meet the moment with technology that drives action.


**About Fidelity Bank**


Fidelity Bank has built a strong history as a trusted financial advisor and continues its mission of exceeding client expectations through a unique banking experience. It operates 21 full-service offices throughout Lackawanna, Luzerne, Lehigh, and Northampton Counties, along with a limited production commercial office in Luzerne County and a Fidelity Bank Wealth Management Office in Schuylkill County. Fidelity Bank provides a digital banking experience online at www.bankatfidelity.com, through the Fidelity[Mobile Banking app](https://www.alkami.com/industry-leading-mobile-banking-platform-for-banks-credit-unions/) , and in the Client Care Center at 1-800-388-4380. Part of the Company’s vision is to serve as the best bank for the community, which was accomplished by having provided over 6,000 hours of volunteer time and over $1.6 million in donations to non-profit organizations directly within the markets served throughout 2025. Fidelity Bank’s deposits are insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation up to the full extent permitted by law.
